items.source: Creates a new EndpointMediaTypes with the given produced and consumed media types.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有给定 produced` 和 consumed` 媒体类型的EndpointMediaTypes。

items.source: Default EndpointMediaTypes for this version of Spring Boot.
items.translation: 此版本的 Spring Boot 默认使用EndpointMediaTypes。

items.source: producedAndConsumed - the default media types that are produced and consumed by an endpoint. Must not be null.
items.translation: producedAndConsumed - 由端点产生和消耗的默认媒体类型。不得为 null。

items.source: Returns the media types consumed by an endpoint.
items.translation: 返回端点所消耗的媒体类型。

items.source: Returns the media types produced by an endpoint.
items.translation: 返回端点生成的媒体类型。

items.source: produced - the default media types that are produced by an endpoint. Must not be null.
items.translation: produced - 由端点生成的默认媒体类型。不能为 null。

items.translation: consumed - 端点所消耗的默认媒体类型。必须为

items.source: Media types that are, by default, produced and consumed by an endpoint.
items.translation: 默认由端点生成和消耗的媒体类型。
